input.quote: Customer commits to purchase at least USD 2,000,000 of Services in each of the next three years on a take-or-pay basis, without reduction or termination rights.
input.rationale: The three-year term in Section 8.1 comes with only for-cause, insolvency, security/service-level and force-majeure termination rights (Sections 9.1–9.5, 27.3); no Customer termination for convenience exists anywhere, and Section 2.1 expressly denies termination rights. Absence of a convenience right in a multi-year term is a walk-away, so we inserted a 30-day right with a pro-rata refund of prepaid Fees.

input.quote: Each Order Form has the initial term stated in it and thereafter renews for successive twelve-month periods unless Customer gives Vendor at least thirty days' written notice of non-renewal. Vendor shall remind Customer of an upcoming renewal at least sixty days beforehand.
input.rationale: Meets the preferred position: 12-month automatic renewals, a 30-day Customer opt-out (extended if Vendor misses the 60-day reminder), and renewal uplift capped at the lesser of CPI and 3% with 90 days' notice under Section 8.3.

input.quote: This Agreement is governed exclusively by Singapore law, and the courts of Singapore have exclusive jurisdiction.
input.rationale: Singapore law with exclusive Singapore venue is outside our accepted list (New York, Delaware, California, England and Wales) and directly conflicts with Section 28.2, which grants exclusive jurisdiction to the New York County courts. We aligned Section 28.1 with New York law and venue.

input.quote: Customer's change of control does not give Vendor a right to terminate, suspend, reprice, accelerate Fees, or reduce service.
input.rationale: Preferred position met: Section 24.1 lets us assign to Affiliates and successors without consent, Section 24.2 restricts Vendor assignment (consent not unreasonably withheld, never to a competitor), and Section 24.4 removes any Vendor right arising on our change of control. Section 13.3 confirms licence transferability.
